## Activity

During March 2026, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 100 captures. This provides the activity measure for the reporting period and reflects the imaging work completed by the site. The capture total should be considered alongside the image-quality and grading results below, as these measures describe how the submitted work progressed through review.

## Image quality

Of the submitted captures, 13 were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 13.0. This result identifies the proportion of images that could not be assessed to the required standard. The finding should support routine review of image acquisition and submission processes at Hill Counties Health Centre, with attention to any recurring factors affecting image usability.

## Grading

There were 18 referable results during March 2026. The median grading lag was 1. This indicates the central time measure for grading during the reporting period. Together, the referable result count and grading lag provide a summary of the clinical review workload and the time taken for results to move through grading. These measures should be monitored with capture activity and image quality to support ongoing site operations.
